todos: Cut the changelog: changelog_log op:"release" version:"{NEW}" moves the entries already in `## [Unreleased]` into `## [{NEW}] - {TODAY}` and opens a fresh `[Unreleased]`. Never draft entries from git log (releases.md § 7). Then add the `**Theme:**` line the user chooses -- the release workflow takes the title from it.

Push the branch, then the tag on its own: the tag push runs release.yml, which builds the AppImage / .exe / .dmg and publishes the release with the CHANGELOG section as its notes. Verify the published body, title and three assets.
